image:image.image:title: Sanssouci, Potsdam
image:image.image:caption: Sanssouci Palace glows floodlit at the top of its famous terraces, the verdigris dome rising against a rain-dark night sky. Espaliered vines and clipped hedges step down the slope in the center and right, with wide stone stairways glistening wet at the left. The 04:15 night-rain scenario turns the gold-lit terraces into mirrors, honest to a rainy Potsdam night.

image:image.image:title: Neues Palais, Potsdam
image:image.image:caption: The Neues Palais stretches along the garden front, its red-ochre baroque façade glowing window after window beneath a dark rainy sky, rooftop statues lining the cornice at the left. The verdigris dome of the rotunda caps the right end above the portico, while wet gravel, fallen leaves, topiary tubs and lit park lamps fill the garden approach. A true night-rain scenario at 04:30, with lamps and warm windows the only light against the dark.

image:image.image:title: Dutch Quarter, Potsdam
image:image.image:caption: A rain-soaked street in Potsdam's Dutch Quarter at night, lined on both sides by the red-brick gabled houses that give the Holländisches Viertel its name. A hanging 'Café Holländisch' sign stands at the left edge, lit shopfronts run the left side while a 'Galerie · Kunsthandwerk' storefront glows at the right edge, and wet cobblestones mirror the lamplight. Fine rain streaks against the dark sky under the scenario's night conditions, with a Mittelstraße street sign anchoring the frame.

image:image.image:title: Babelsberg Park, Potsdam
image:image.image:caption: Schloss Babelsberg glows from its terraces above the Havel on a rainy night, its sandstone towers and neo-Gothic windows lit against the dark park. A wet stone terrace with fallen leaves runs along the left foreground while the river spreads across the left frame, carrying the reflected lights of distant Potsdam. Rain hangs in the lamplight and night sky under the scenario's slight-rain conditions, the park's trees and slopes fading into the blue-dark beyond.

image:image.image:title: Cecilienhof, Potsdam
image:image.image:caption: Cecilienhof Palace seen through a stone archway into its courtyard on a rainy night, the Tudor-style frontage rising left of frame with herringbone timbering, tall chimneys and warm leaded windows. A circular flower bed rings the lawn in the courtyard foreground while the right wing closes the composition, both glowing against the dark. Rain streaks the night sky above under the scenario's slight-rain conditions, lit lanterns and window glow lending the Potsdam Conference site its evening warmth.

image:image.image:title: Glienicke Bridge, Potsdam/Berlin boundary
image:image.image:caption: Seen from the rain-slicked riverside promenade before dawn, the Glienicke Bridge's green steel trusses stretch across the frame, its row of warm lampposts glowing through the night rain. The stone bridge abutment anchors the left foreground while the dark Havel shimmers with wet reflections below, and distant bank lights blur softly through the drizzle on the right.

image:image.image:title: Spreewald canals, Lübbenau-Lehde
image:image.image:caption: The Spreewald canal runs straight into the frame beneath a low wooden footbridge, its still water mirroring the overcast sky. To the left, thatched-roof timber cottages with flower-filled gardens line the bank and a tarp-covered punt rests at the wooden landing; to the right, willows and a pale-blue waterside house sit among lush late-September greenery. The 17:30 light is soft and diffuse under heavy cloud, carrying the bridge's reflection on the canal's quiet surface.

image:image.image:title: Spreewald waterways, Burg
image:image.image:caption: From the canal bank at pre-dawn, a narrow waterway winds past reed beds and misty meadows under a heavy overcast night sky. A wooden rowboat lies moored in the left foreground, a small footbridge arches over the canal mid-frame, and thatched-roof cottages glow with warm lamplight on the right bank, a 'Burg-Lübbener-Kanal' wayfinding sign standing at the grassy edge.

image:image.image:title: Rheinsberg Palace, Rheinsberg
image:image.image:caption: From the lakeside path before dawn, Rheinsberg Palace stands across the water with its twin round towers and red roofs, its warm windows mirrored faintly in the lake. Rain streaks drift through the pre-dawn gloom while a weathered wooden jetty reaches into the foreground at right, and overhanging trees frame the palace from the right edge.

image:image.image:title: Chorin Abbey, Chorin
image:image.image:caption: From a rain-damp cloister courtyard before dawn, the visitor looks across wet cobbles to the brick Gothic gables of Chorin Abbey: the tall church front with its lancet windows and slim green spire rises at the right, weathered red-brick arcades line both sides, and ivy drapes the left colonnade. Faint light and rain streaks give the scene a quiet, brooding stillness.

image:image.image:title: Neuzelle Abbey, Neuzelle
image:image.image:caption: Before dawn in the monastery garden, the visitor looks across a wet gravel path to the baroque splendour of Neuzelle Abbey: the domed church glows from within at the left, the orange-and-white baroque church front with its twin dark spires rises at the right, and a long lamp-lit cloister wall with arched openings links them. Manicured cone topiary and a stone Kloster Neuzelle sign frame the quiet, damp scene.

image:image.image:title: Branitz Park, Cottbus
image:image.image:caption: From the rain-wet lakeshore before dawn, the visitor watches the grass-topped Seepyramide rise from the dark, rain-rippled water at the center of the frame, park lamps glowing along the left shore and doubling as reflections. Reeds and a small wooden Branitz Park Seepyramide sign fill the left foreground while dense trees close the far shore, lending the scene a calm, rain-softened stillness.

image:image.image:title: Beelitz-Heilstätten, Beelitz
image:image.image:caption: The red-brick sanatorium facade rises at right of frame, its tall arched windows and creeper-covered walls under a low overcast sky. A green-canopied NOTAUFNAHME porch juts toward the viewer at center, with an interpretive plaque standing in the gravel foreground. Warm lamps line the wet path to the left where autumn treetops thin against the grey clouds, the glow softened by early-morning mist.

image:image.image:title: Ship lifts, Niederfinow
image:image.image:caption: The new concrete ship lift towers right of frame with its yellow machinery houses floodlit, while the old riveted steel lift spans the background at left. A lightning fork splits the storm clouds overhead as rain streaks across the dark sky, and the wet canal water glistens between the quay walls. Street lamps and a green German information sign anchor the left foreground in the downpour.

image:image.image:title: Cathedral island, Brandenburg an der Havel
image:image.image:caption: The brick Gothic cathedral stands center-right on its island in the Havel, its tall spire piercing a moonlit partly cloudy sky. Lit windows glow against the dark stone while gas lamps line the cobbled embankment at left, their light pooling on the wet cobbles. A wooden boat bobs at the mooring posts in the foreground, and the far shore of the river glimmers with town lights to the right.

image:image.image:title: Island old town, Werder (Havel)
image:image.image:caption: The floodlit neo-Gothic Heilig-Geist-Kirche stands center on Werder's island old town, its tall spire rising against broken night clouds. Moored wooden boats bob at the cobbled quayside on the left, old-town houses glowing warm along the banks, and an arched stone bridge crossing the Havel at the right edge — light and water reflections woven across the frame.

image:image.image:title: Forst Rose Garden, Forst (Lausitz)
image:image.image:caption: A lamp-lit stone pergola stands at the right of the formal rose parterre, its warm lanterns glowing against the night. Clipped box-hedge beds edged with rose bushes frame a weathered stone urn at the center, with white benches tucked along the paths and a dark canopy of mature trees rising behind under an overcast sky.

image:image.image:title: Town walls, Templin
image:image.image:caption: The crenellated brick gate tower rises center, its arched passage leading into the wet historic street beyond. A mossy fieldstone wall runs left toward the gate, while half-timbered houses with a bakery awning line the right; rain slicks the cobbles under a heavy grey daytime sky, with another tower glimpsed through the arch.

image:image.image:title: Brandenburg Gate, Mitte
image:image.image:caption: The floodlit Brandenburg Gate stands centered from Pariser Platz, its six Doric columns and the Quadriga glowing warm against a partly-cloudy night sky. Historic facades with lit windows frame the square left and right — the Adlon Kempinski at the left edge — while wet cobblestones catch reflections in the foreground and a "Pariser Platz" street sign and two parked e-scooters anchor the empty plaza at 01:00.

image:image.image:title: Reichstag, Tiergarten
image:image.image:caption: Foster's glass dome glows above the Reichstag's historic stone façade, its illuminated portico and DEM DEUTSCHEN VOLKE pediment at centre frame with German flags flying on both corner towers. A lit streetlamp and the Tiergarten park sign stand at the left edge, with wet plaza paving in the foreground mirroring the building's warm lights under the overcast 01:15 night sky.

image:image.image:title: Museum Island, Mitte
image:image.image:caption: The Berlin Cathedral's greenish dome rises centre-left above the Spree, its warm lit windows reflected in the dark river; the colonnaded Alte Nationalgalerie runs the length of the right bank with light spilling between its columns. The bridge to the left leads toward the lit Bode dome with the Fernsehturm a faint presence in the distance, all under the heavy overcast night sky of the 01:15 scenario.

image:image.image:title: Berlin Cathedral, Mitte
image:image.image:caption: The Berlin Cathedral's patina-green dome towers centre frame, flanked by its twin bell towers, the floodlit stone façade and sculptural entrance portico glowing against the overcast night sky. Dark trees line the Lustgarten park at left, while streetlamps trace the path along the right edge; a lone pedestrian's silhouette crosses the far right under the 01:30 night scenario.

image:image.image:title: Bode Museum, Mitte
image:image.image:caption: The domed Bode Museum glows from within on the Museum Island tip at 1:45 AM, its baroque silhouette rising over the Spree river junction. Stone arch bridges span the dark water at left and right of the frame, with faint city buildings beyond the left bank. Warm light spills from the museum's arched windows and riverside lamps against the overcast night sky.

image:image.image:title: Gendarmenmarkt, Mitte
image:image.image:caption: The floodlit Konzerthaus stands at the center of Gendarmenmarkt at 1:45 AM, flanked by the twin domed cathedrals on the left and right, with the Schiller statue on its forecourt facing the empty plaza. Wet cobbles mirror the warm window light beneath the overcast night sky, and shuttered café terraces with stacked furniture sit at the right edge.

image:image.image:title: Alexanderplatz, Mitte
image:image.image:caption: The TV Tower rises over Alexanderplatz at 2:00 AM, its lit sphere and beacon standing above the station arches with their red neon ALEXANDERPLATZ sign at the left of the frame. Tram wires crisscross the overcast sky, glowing shopfronts line the square, and the high-rise hotel with its rooftop sign anchors the right side, all reflected in the rain-damp pavement.

image:image.image:title: East Side Gallery, Friedrichshain
image:image.image:caption: From an eye-level night viewpoint on the Spree-side promenade, the mural-covered Wall runs diagonally through the frame: the bold EAST SIDE GALLERY lettering fills the foreground segment at left, a green cartoon-creature mural and a blue 'SIEBEN STUFEN' piece anchor the center, and the long painted run recedes toward street lamps and apartment façades at right. Overcast night sky and wet-looking pavement set the 02:15 mood, with stickers and tags layered thick across the concrete like the real gallery wall.

image:image.image:title: Oberbaum Bridge, Friedrichshain/Kreuzberg
image:image.image:caption: From an eye-level night viewpoint on the riverside promenade, the Oberbaum Bridge's two red-brick neo-Gothic towers rise from the Spree at left and center, their conical spires and finial figures silhouetted against an overcast night sky. The arched brick viaduct carries a light-streaked U-Bahn train across the middle of the frame, while the warmly lit brick wing with its small arches fills the right side and water reflections shimmer beneath.

image:image.image:title: Charlottenburg Palace, Charlottenburg
image:image.image:caption: From an eye-level night viewpoint in the parterre gardens, the floodlit Charlottenburg Palace stands centered with its signature turquoise dome and golden finial crowning the warm ochre façade. Clipped hedges and glowing vintage lanterns flank the garden path leading toward the lit windows, a putto statue anchors the left foreground and a dark reflecting pond the right, all under a partly cloudy night sky.

image:image.image:title: Victory Column, Tiergarten
image:image.image:caption: The Victory Column rises from the Großer Stern roundabout under a dark overcast sky, its gilded Victoria catching the lamplight at the top of the fluted drum. To the left, the tree-lined Straße des 17. Juni recedes in a string of glowing street lanterns, rainwater pooling on the avenue and throwing their light back. A lit direction sign at the right names Großer Stern, the Brandenburg Gate and the Reichstag, and autumn-brown leaves fringe the frame — a still, empty 2:45 a.m. view from the western pavement.

image:image.image:title: Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe, Mitte
image:image.image:caption: The Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe spreads its field of concrete stelae under a brooding overcast night sky, the grey slabs rising and falling in uneven heights. An information plaque in the left foreground names the site in German, while streetlamps cast warm pools of light on the rain-streaked stone. Behind the field, the lit office towers of Mitte glow through the dark, and fallen leaves gather in puddles between the rows — a solemn 2:45 a.m. visit with the memorial empty and still.

image:image.image:title: Berlin Wall Memorial, Mitte
image:image.image:caption: The Berlin Wall Memorial's preserved border strip on Bernauer Straße lies under a heavy overcast night sky: a graffiti-marked wall segment on the left, rust-brown Corten steel posts tracing the vanished border course, and the glowing glass visitor center mid-frame. Bilingual plaques name the Gedenkstätte Berliner Mauer and the Grenzverlauf 1961–1989, streetlamps warm the wet pavement and apartment windows beyond. A still 3:00 a.m. view along the grass death strip — empty, watchful, unadorned.

image:image.image:title: Checkpoint Charlie, Kreuzberg/Mitte
image:image.image:caption: A quiet nighttime view of the Checkpoint Charlie memorial hut on Friedrichstraße, its sandbag barrier piled in front and the rooftop sign lit above. Behind it stands the Haus am Checkpoint Charlie with the glowing "WALL MUSEUM" lettering to the left, while the "MAUERMUSEUM" sign runs down the right edge. Street lamps and the booth's own lights reflect off the wet pavement under an overcast sky, giving the familiar tourist stop an unusually still, after-hours mood.

image:image.image:title: Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church, Charlottenburg
image:image.image:caption: A night view of the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church from Breitscheidplatz: the war-damaged neo-Romanesque tower ruin, its open belfry and scarred stonework warmly lit, stands left of the glowing blue glass-block belfry of the modern church. The "Kurfürstendamm" street sign glows at the frame's edge under an overcast sky, with street lamps and wet pavement scattered with autumn leaves reflecting the blue light in the quiet square.

image:image.image:title: Nikolaiviertel, Mitte
image:image.image:caption: The Nikolaikirche's twin green-copper spires rise at the end of a wet cobbled lane in Berlin's Nikolaiviertel, the brick Gothic towers warmly lit from within. Historic-style houses line the lane — a weinstube and café with wrought-iron hanging signs and glowing shopfront windows to the left, café umbrellas folded for the night to the right. Lanterns reflect off the rain-darkened cobbles under an overcast night sky, the empty street giving the old quarter a hushed, after-hours mood.

image:image.image:title: Hackesche Höfe, Mitte
image:image.image:caption: The August Endell courtyard rises on all sides in its signature glazed blue-and-white faience tiles, geometric frieze panels running across the upper floors and a curved, tiled gable anchoring the center of the frame. Warm lantern light spills from the bookshop and gallery doorways at street level while the wet cobbles mirror every glow. Under the overcast 03:45 night sky the Art Nouveau façades read dark and graphic, the courtyard empty and hushed.

image:image.image:title: Teufelsberg, Grunewald
image:image.image:caption: The Cold War listening station rises out of the Grunewald pines: torn white radome domes crowning graffiti-tagged concrete towers, the entrance sign TEUFELSBERG · EHEMALIGE ABHÖRSTATION visible at the lower left. Rain streaks through the beam-lit darkness while puddles on the broken ground mirror the station lights. The skeletal annex blocks and exposed steel framing give the whole scene its signature derelict monumentality.

image:image.image:title: Spree riverfront, Treptow
image:image.image:caption: The perforated aluminum figures of Molecule Man stand mid-river with city lights glowing through their bodies, the illuminated Oberbaumbrücke arches stretching left and the Berliner Fernsehturm spire rising at the right edge. The Spree mirrors the riverside lights while the partly cloudy 04:00 sky holds the last blue of night above the skyline. A riverside railing and fallen autumn leaves anchor the tourist viewpoint in the foreground.

image:image.image:title: Old town and palace, Köpenick
image:image.image:caption: Night rain glazes the cobbles of Köpenick's old-town riverfront, where lit historic townhouses — brick and half-timbered — line the left bank under glowing streetlamps. A moored boat sits mid-frame while the floodlit palace rises across the water at the right edge, its reflection broken by falling rain. The 04:15 scenario is a true night scene: dark blue-black sky, wet sheens everywhere, and lamps the only warm light.

image:image.image:title: Old Bridge and castle, Heidelberg
image:image.image:caption: The stone arches of the Old Bridge cross the Neckar in the foreground, its parapet lamps and the castle's floodlit walls doubled in the dark water below. Heidelberg Castle stands on the wooded hill behind, its terraces and round towers glowing warm against the night. A thin crescent moon hangs in the upper right, and the old town's gabled houses are lit along the right bank in the 03:00 night scenario.

image:image.image:title: Philosophenweg, Heidelberg
image:image.image:caption: The viewpoint is the Philosophenweg itself, with pines and a metal railing at the left edge, looking down and across the whole old town. The illuminated castle glows on its hill at center-right, the lit Old Bridge arcs over the dark Neckar, and rooftops, church towers and streetlights fill the valley. The 04:15 night scenario reads as a full city-lights panorama under a deep blue pre-dawn sky.

image:image.image:title: Hohenzollern Castle, Hechingen/Bisingen
image:image.image:caption: Hohenzollern Castle sits centered on its hilltop, a pre-dawn blue-grey silhouette with warm windows glowing through the mist. Its cluster of towers and spires rises above fog pooled in the valleys, framed by dark foreground branches and pines on either side. In the 05:15 scenario the castle is the single lit mass in an otherwise sleeping landscape.

image:image.image:title: Lichtenstein Castle, Lichtenstein
image:image.image:caption: Lichtenstein Castle stands at the left of the frame on its cliff, the white round tower and warmly lit windows rising above the rocky drop. A stone access bridge crosses in from the far left, while the gorge and forested hills fall away to the right. In the 06:15 pre-dawn scene a moon breaks through cloud, pairing cold moonlight on the stone with the castle's interior glow.

image:image.image:title: Ulm Minster, Ulm
image:image.image:caption: Ulm Minster's tall openwork spire fills the center of the frame, rising from the west facade with its great carved portal into low morning cloud. Market-side buildings flank the square at left and right, and the sky is a soft pale grey. The 07:15 shot is taken straight-on from the plaza, giving the tower its full vertical presence.

image:image.image:title: Fishermen’s Quarter, Ulm
image:image.image:caption: The canal runs between rows of crooked half-timbered houses, their weathered timber and shuttered windows leaning over the water. A small stone bridge crosses in the misty distance, a wooden boat is moored at the right bank, and a painted 'Biergarten · Fischerviertel' sign marks a doorway on the right. The 08:15 morning hangs damp and grey, true to the quarter's enclosed, overhanging character.

image:image.image:title: Minster and Münsterplatz, Freiburg
image:image.image:caption: Freiburg Minster's openwork spire rises at center, with the cathedral's long red sandstone nave stretching to the right. The market square in front is full of produce stalls under striped awnings, with heaped apples and greens in the foreground. A red merchant house with an ornate painted oriel window frames the square at left, and the 09:15 morning is clear and bright. One honest artifact: a small in-scene digital sign reads 10:23 against the baked 09:15 scenario label, a documented generation quirk.

image:image.image:title: Schwabentor, Freiburg
image:image.image:caption: The Schwabentor gate tower stands center, its blue clock face and painted fresco panel set above twin passage arches, with half-timbered gables crowding in on either side. Cobbles run through the arches and curve away to the right, and a 'Bäckerei · Brot & Gebäck' shop front sits at the left edge. The 10:15 morning is clear and sunny, and the tower's stone quoins and timber framing read crisply in the light.

image:image.image:title: Kurhaus, Baden-Baden
image:image.image:caption: The Kurhaus presents its white neoclassical frontage across the center of the frame, a long colonnade of columns under a decorated frieze, with KURHAUS lettered on the left wing. Formal flower beds, clipped hedges and gravel walks with iron benches fill the foreground, backed by the wooded hillside. The 11:15 morning is bright and clear, and a small 'Kurpark · Lichtentaler Allee · Baden-Baden' sign stands in the right foreground.

image:image.image:title: Lichtentaler Allee, Baden-Baden
image:image.image:caption: The Oos river flows along the right of the frame beneath a footbridge, its banks lined with mature trees, benches and low stone walls. The park path runs through the center past flower beds, with a colonnaded pavilion glimpsed in the distance and grand villas rising at the right edge. A wooden 'Lichtentaler Allee · entlang der Oos' sign anchors the left foreground in dappled 12:15 midday sun.

image:image.image:title: Triberg Waterfalls, Triberg
image:image.image:caption: The waterfall drops in a multi-tiered cascade down the center of the frame, white water threading between moss-covered boulders and dark spruce. A trail sign at the left marks the Triberg falls and their 163 m height, and a wooden footbridge crosses near the top of the cascade. The 13:15 early-afternoon light filters green through the forest canopy over the viewing path.

image:image.image:title: Vogtsbauernhof, Gutach
image:image.image:caption: Three thatched Black Forest farmhouses cluster in the frame: a dark timber house at left with a flower-covered balcony, the white half-timbered main house at center, and another timber barn at right. Wagon wheels lean against the fences, and flower beds and vegetable plots fill the foreground with forested hills behind. The 14:15 afternoon is bright and sunny, and a wooden sign naming the open-air museum stands at the right foreground. Per the approval note, the signature slightly overlaps that sign's edge, though both remain legible.

image:image.image:title: Mummelsee, Seebach
image:image.image:caption: Mummelsee stretches calm across the frame, its surface mirroring the dense spruce shoreline that walls the lake on three sides. The near shore holds mossy rocks, reeds and wild mushrooms in the foreground, while a small wooden hut sits on the far shore at right. Forested mountains rise behind under the clear 15:15 afternoon sky.

image:image.image:title: Feldberg summit area, Feldberg
image:image.image:caption: The viewpoint is the Feldberg summit itself: a weathered wooden sign at left reads 'Feldberg 1493 m · Höchster Gipfel im Schwarzwald', beside a stone cairn carrying a summit-book box and brass plaque at right. The communications tower crowns the rocky summit behind, and the Black Forest hills roll away in layered blue-green ridges to a hazy horizon. The 16:15 afternoon is clear and bright, over the highest summit in the Black Forest.

image:image.image:title: Titisee, Titisee-Neustadt
image:image.image:caption: A wooden jetty juts from the reeds into the calm lake in the foreground, framed by pine branches at both edges. Across the water, shoreline hotels and chalets with boathouses line the far bank, backed by steep forested hills under a clear blue sky. The 17:15 late-afternoon sun sparkles on the water, at Titisee in Titisee-Neustadt.

image:image.image:title: Blautopf, Blautal/Blaubeuren
image:image.image:caption: The view looks across the vividly turquoise Blautopf spring from the near bank, where the water's clarity reveals the spring's depths. The half-timbered mill with its terracotta roof and wooden waterwheel stands at the left, its reflection doubled in the still surface. Dense green forest fills the right and rises behind, with a wooden fence edging the far shore. The 18:15 light is bright early-evening daylight under a clear sky.

image:image.image:title: Old town and harbor, Meersburg
image:image.image:caption: The viewpoint is the harbor itself, looking back at Meersburg climbing the hill, with moored boats — a red rowboat and a white sailboat nearest the camera — filling the foreground. The waterfront row runs through the center: a prominent red stepped-gable house in the middle, pastel houses with flower boxes flanking it, and a small wooden kiosk signed Hafen Meersburg at the right edge beside a lit streetlamp. Above them rise the stone castle and the church tower, with baroque buildings on the right slope. The 19:15 light is still full early-evening daylight.

image:image.image:title: Harbor and Imperia, Konstanz
image:image.image:caption: A night view across the Konstanz harbor under a dark, starry sky, the scene lit by streetlamps and marina lights. The Imperia statue — a robed figure holding two small figures aloft — stands on its stone pedestal at the right of the pier entrance. Behind it to the left, the small harbor tower with its glowing windows burns warm against the night, with mooring posts and dark water in the foreground and the town's lights stretching along the shore. The 20:15 scenario is rendered as true night.

image:image.image:title: Island gardens, Mainau
image:image.image:caption: The camera stands on the curving gravel path of the garden parterre at night. In the center, the baroque Mainau palace glows with lit windows and a cupola tower at its right. Colorful flower beds and trimmed hedges fill the foreground on both sides, picked out by garden lamps, with a wooden sign reading Insel Mainau · Schlossgarten at the left. The lake glints at the right edge under a starry 21:15 sky.

image:image.image:title: Monastic churches, Reichenau
image:image.image:caption: The view approaches the monastery across the fields under a starry sky with a crescent moon. In the center stands the stone monastic church with its towers, one capped by an onion dome; to its right a half-timbered building glows from a lit doorway. The foreground is given over to cultivated cabbage fields and a gravel path running beside a stone wall on the right, with the lake visible far to the left. Warm lamps light the buildings against the cold blue of the 22:15 night.

image:image.image:title: Schlossplatz, Stuttgart
image:image.image:caption: The view across Schlossplatz centers on the tall Jubiläumssäule column crowned by the angel figure, with bronze statues at its base. On either side, two fountains glow blue in the dark, and behind them the lit baroque façade of the Neues Schloss stretches across the frame, its windows warm. Manicured lawns and flowerbeds fill the foreground, and a domed building appears at the far left. The 23:15 scene is full night with a starry sky over the empty square.

image:image.image:title: Residential Palace, Ludwigsburg
image:image.image:caption: The symmetrical baroque Residential Palace façade fills the frame, viewed from the forecourt at night. The central block rises at center with its mansard roof, clock, green-domed cupola, and rooftop statuary, every window lit warm yellow. Matching wings extend to the left and right, their ground floors glowing under wall lanterns. In the foreground, the lion fountain with its dark sculpture anchors the courtyard under a 00:15 deep-night sky with stars overhead.

image:image.image:title: Palace gardens, Schwetzingen
image:image.image:caption: The view runs down the garden's great axis at night, the baroque parterre hedges forming geometric patterns in the foreground. The illuminated domed Turkish Garden pavilion stands at the right, its arched colonnade and minaret-like towers glowing warm. Far down the central walk, the round Temple of Apollo pavilion sits on the axis with the palace building faintly behind it, while a lamplit avenue of clipped trees lines the left. The 01:15 sky is dark and starry above the floodlit gardens.

image:image.image:title: Monastery courtyard, Maulbronn
image:image.image:caption: The camera stands in the monastery courtyard at night, looking across the central fountain toward the buildings. To the left rises the gothic monastery church with its tall spire and traceried windows; to the right, the sandstone cloister range presents its row of arched arcades. A half-timbered ancillary building closes the middle distance. Warm wall lanterns wash the courtyard, and the moon and stars hang in the 02:15 sky.

image:image.image:title: Market square, Schiltach
image:image.image:caption: The famous half-timbered Rathaus dominates the square, viewed at night from the cobbled plaza. Its red-and-white timber framing, painted gable fresco, and copper-roofed tower with weathervane fill the center, flanked by matching gabled half-timbered houses on both sides of the square. The street is lamplit and empty except for folded café umbrellas and barrels in the right foreground; a street sign reads MARKTPLATZ and a small display shows 5.8°C at the left. The 03:15 sky is dark and starry.

image:image.image:title: Historic town center, Gengenbach
image:image.image:caption: The pink-and-white baroque Rathaus fills the center of the frame, its clock gable, rooftop statues, and ground-floor arcade all floodlit. Colorful half-timbered houses flank the scene on both sides — a café sign hangs at the left — and wooded hills rise behind under a starry sky. The 04:15 scene is night, with the square empty and the town's windows still lit.

image:image.image:title: Old town and canals, Esslingen
image:image.image:caption: The view looks up the lamplit canal toward the Stadtkirche, whose two spires are joined by the distinctive flying bridge. A large timber-framed house with a glowing restaurant terrace occupies the right foreground at the water's edge, and gabled houses line the stone canal embankment on the left. Warm windows and streetlamps reflect on the dark water. The 05:15 sky is deep blue and starry — pre-dawn night rather than dawn light.

image:image.image:title: Neckarfront, Tübingen
image:image.image:caption: The camera sits low near the Neckar at night, looking along the famous riverfront row. The yellow Hölderlin Tower stands at the left beside the water, where wooden punts are moored. The row of tall, colorful gabled houses runs from center to the right, their windows glowing, with the riverside path and its lamplight reflections on the water in the foreground. The 06:15 sky still holds a crescent moon — the scene is rendered as night, honest to the hour before sunrise.

image:image.image:title: Hohentwiel, Singen
image:image.image:caption: The view is from within the fortress ruins atop the Hohentwiel volcanic hill. Weathered stone walls and a lone burning lamp fill the foreground, while the dark volcanic cone falls away below. To the right, the lights of Singen spread across the plain in the valley. The eastern sky glows warm amber along the horizon in honest civil-twilight light, the landscape still held in blue-hour shadow with no stars; the audit notes frost-rimmed grass consistent with the 7.0°C morning.

image:image.image:title: Europa-Park, Rust
image:image.image:caption: The view faces the Europa-Park entrance at dawn, the illuminated EUROPA PARK arch signage with its fanlight canopy centered in the frame. Half-timbered façades flank it: a bakery with a pretzel sign at the left and a souvenir shop at the right, both lamplit on the cobblestone plaza. A roller-coaster silhouette rises at the right edge. Warm pre-sunrise light glows through the entrance arches while the buildings sit in blue-hour shadow — an honest 07:15 twilight, not full daylight and not night.

image:image.image:title: Neuschwanstein Castle, Schwangau
image:image.image:caption: From the Marienbrücke, the bridge's metal lattice railing crosses the foreground while the white limestone castle rises through low cloud to the right, its towers and dark roofs half-veiled in mist. The rocky Pöllat gorge cliff with fir trees fills the left of the frame, and green forest fades into the fog below. It is a flat, fog-shrouded early morning — 07:45 — and the soft diffuse light matches the reported fog scenario exactly.

image:image.image:title: Hohenschwangau Castle, Schwangau
image:image.image:caption: Standing in a wet cobbled village street, the yellow neo-Gothic castle with its towers and battlements rises through the mist at the head of the view, framed by fog-draped forested slopes. Timber-framed and chalet-style houses line the street on both sides, with an old lamppost on the left and a lit bakery shopfront on the right. It is a foggy 08:15 morning, and puddles on the cobbles reflect the pale light — the yellow-castle-over-village composition the scene is built around.

image:image.image:title: Alpsee, Schwangau
image:image.image:caption: From the lakeshore at eye level, reeds and shallows fill the foreground while mist lies flat over the Alpsee and fog-draped mountains close in on both sides. A faint castle-like silhouette shows through the fog on the far left shore, near a small white-and-red building across the water. The still, grey, foggy morning air — 08:45, 5.5°C — leaves only the nearest shoreline in real detail.

image:image.image:title: Eibsee, Grainau
image:image.image:caption: From the mossy lakeshore, the Eibsee spreads across the frame with its signature rocky islets: pines crowd the large islet on the left and smaller tree-topped rocks sit mid-frame and right. The Zugspitze massif fills the background under a clear blue sky, its grey limestone ridges carrying patches of snow, with a cable-car line visible on the slopes. Fallen leaves float on the glassy water in the foreground, and the bright 09:15 mid-morning light sharpens every reflection.

image:image.image:title: Zugspitze, Garmisch-Partenkirchen
image:image.image:caption: On the Zugspitze viewing terrace, the summit station and observatory building with its grey dome stand on the left, while the brass plaque "Zugspitze 2962 m – höchster Gipfel Deutschlands" is fixed to the railing in the foreground. A summit cross rises on the crag at the right edge, and the vast Alps panorama rolls away beyond under a clear blue sky. An on-terrace display panel reads 10.0°C with clear, lightly windy conditions — the bright 09:45 morning of the scenario.

image:image.image:title: Partnach Gorge, Garmisch-Partenkirchen
image:image.image:caption: Inside the narrow Partnach Gorge, steep moss-covered limestone walls rise on both sides, framing the blue Partnach stream as it runs down the middle of the frame. The railed wooden boardwalk cuts along the left bank in the foreground, and a slot of blue sky shows far above between the cliffs. It is bright 10:15 daylight, with sun catching the green moss and white water against the deep shadow of the gorge.

image:image.image:title: Geroldsee, Krün / Gerold
image:image.image:caption: From the meadow edge at eye level, the calm Geroldsee lies across the middle of the frame, mirroring the snow-dusted Karwendel massif that rises behind it. A flower-filled meadow with reeds and grasses fills the foreground, a small wooden hut sits on the right shore, and dark conifer forest wraps the far bank. The clear 10:45 late-morning sun lights the meadow gold and doubles the mountains in the lake.

image:image.image:title: Königssee, Schönau am Königssee
image:image.image:caption: From the rocky lakeshore, the emerald Königssee fills the lower frame with mountain reflections, while a wooden bench and fallen timber sit in the left foreground. On the right, a small boathouse and jetty hold a wooden rowing boat, and steep forested mountain walls rise on both sides toward craggy grey peaks with patches of late-summer snow. The bright 11:15 mid-morning sun is on the water, and the fjord-like lake-between-walls geography reads clearly.

image:image.image:title: St. Bartholomä, Schönau am Königssee
image:image.image:caption: From the accessible shore, the white St. Bartholomä pilgrimage church with its signature red onion domes stands on the right, with a clock visible on the small tower. A dark timber boathouse and wooden jetty with a rowboat sit at the water's edge in the center, and the calm green lake stretches left toward the forested far shore. The Watzmann massif rises behind everything under clear blue sky — bright 11:45 midday light.

image:image.image:title: Obersee, Schönau am Königssee
image:image.image:caption: From the lakeshore, the Obersee's clear water fills the foreground and left, with the wooden boathouse standing at the right-hand shore and several wooden rowboats moored alongside it. Forested slopes close in on the left while the snow-capped Teufelshörner and Watzmann peaks rise behind, reflected in the calm surface. It is clear 12:15 midday under a blue sky, and the shallows in the foreground show stones through the glass-clear water.

image:image.image:title: Parish church of St. Sebastian, Ramsau
image:image.image:caption: The white Baroque parish church of St. Sebastian stands at the center with its distinctive dark onion dome on the west tower, enclosed by the churchyard wall. The Ramsauer Ache stream runs through the foreground with a wooden footbridge crossing it at left, leading the eye to the church. The Reiteralpe massif rises behind under a blue midday sky — bright 12:45 light with lush green banks and meadows.

image:image.image:title: Hintersee, Ramsau
image:image.image:caption: From the lakeshore at eye level, large moss-covered boulders fill the foreground while the clear shallow water of the Hintersee stretches toward a forested shoreline. Steep mountain walls rise behind, wooded at their feet and rocky above, with a small distant building visible across the lake near the center. It is a bright 13:15 afternoon under a mainly clear sky, with stones and fallen timber showing through the shallows in front.

image:image.image:title: Kehlsteinhaus, Berchtesgaden
image:image.image:caption: The stone chalet of the Kehlsteinhaus sits left of frame, its mountain terrace and railed overlook plaza spreading to the right, with a communications mast rising behind the roof. An alpine panorama fills the rest of the view: forested ridges and a pale limestone massif stretching across the horizon. In the near foreground a wooden bench carries a visitor's jacket, a metal water bottle, pine cones and a folded map, as if a hiker has just set things down. Bright midday sun and a clear sky complete the summit viewpoint.

image:image.image:title: Maria Gern, Berchtesgaden
image:image.image:caption: The pale-pink Maria Gern pilgrimage church stands at the right, its onion-domed tower rising against the snow-dusted Watzmann massif that dominates the centre and background. A wildflower meadow fills the foreground, with a narrow hiking trail curving in from the left and a wooden trail marker post at the left edge. Mid-afternoon daylight under a clear blue sky keeps the whole classic church-and-mountain composition crisp.

image:image.image:title: Lechfall, Füssen
image:image.image:caption: The Lechfall's stepped weir drops through the centre of the frame, white water tumbling down the terraces into the rocky gorge, with turquoise Lech water below. A slender pedestrian bridge spans the river above the falls, framed by steep mossy rock walls on both sides. Forested hillsides rise behind under a bright mid-afternoon sky, and green undergrowth lines the near foreground rocks.

image:image.image:title: Old town, Mittenwald
image:image.image:caption: The view looks down a cobbled old-town street, with Lüftlmalerei-painted facades lining both sides: green shutters, flower boxes and large fresco scenes on the left building, which carries a violin-maker's shop sign at street level. The jagged Karwendel peaks rise dead ahead above the rooftops, closing the street in a wall of rock. Warm mid-afternoon light falls across the shopfronts, which are quiet and empty of crowds.

image:image.image:title: Linderhof Palace, Ettal
image:image.image:caption: From the lower gardens the fountain pool fills the centre foreground, its golden sculpture group mirrored in the still water, with dark ornamental urns and trimmed hedges flanking the garden axis on both sides. The palace's ornate white façade stands at the end of the axis, framed by dense green woodland and a forested mountain rising behind. A wooden bench and a small sign reading 'Linderhof Palace • Schlosspark Garden Axis' sit in the left foreground, marking the tourist's vantage point. Bright afternoon sun bathes the whole parterre.

image:image.image:title: Ettal Abbey, Ettal
image:image.image:caption: The great copper-green dome of the abbey church dominates the centre, flanked by its two onion-domed towers, viewed head-on from a cobbled garden path. A monastery wing extends to the left and a stone garden wall with trees to the right, with forested mountain slopes behind. Late-afternoon light softens the white walls; a small in-scene wooden abbey sign near the path is partly covered by the caption text, a cosmetic overlap only.

image:image.image:title: Wieskirche, Steingaden
image:image.image:caption: The white rococo church body with its red-tiled roof stretches across the left and centre, while the tall east tower with its dark dome and clock face rises to the right, framed by two leafy trees. A wooden fence and a dirt path curve through the yellow-flowered meadow in the foreground toward the church. Forested foothills sit behind under a lightly cloudy late-afternoon sky.

image:image.image:title: Marienplatz, Munich
image:image.image:caption: The neo-Gothic New Town Hall fills the frame at eye level: the central Glockenspiel bay and clock tower rise in the middle, flanked by gabled bays with pointed spires left and right. Ground-floor arcades carry Tourist Information signage, and café umbrellas and blurred pedestrians move across the plaza paving below. A partly cloudy late-afternoon sky hangs above the façade; some shop-sign lettering renders as AI-style gibberish, a legibility nit rather than a location defect.

image:image.image:title: Nymphenburg Palace, Munich
image:image.image:caption: The long rectangular canal leads the eye from the foreground straight to the palace, its water framed by mossy stone edges, reeds and a gravel path on the left. The white baroque main pavilion stands at the centre with its mansard roof, flanked by low gallery wings and red-tiled side pavilions; statues dot the lawns on either side. Mature trees overhang the top of the frame and fill the right, and a partly cloudy late-afternoon sky reflects softly in the water.

image:image.image:title: English Garden, Munich
image:image.image:caption: The domed Monopteros temple stands right of centre atop its grassy hill, its ring of columns open to the sky, reached by a curving dirt footpath from the lower left with a bench beside it. Wildflower meadows and mature trees surround the mound, with Munich's rooftops and a distant skyline along the left horizon. Broken cloud drifts overhead in the early-evening daylight.

image:image.image:title: Olympiapark, Munich
image:image.image:caption: The Olympic Lake fills the lower left foreground, its reed-fringed shallows giving way to the great acrylic-glass tent roofs of the Olympic Stadium spreading across the centre and right, held on steel cables and pylons. The grassy Olympiaberg hill rises behind on the left, its summit staircase zigzagging up to the top. A wooden park wayfinding sign in the right foreground points to the Olympiastadion and Olympiaberg, under bright daylight with patches of overcast cloud.

image:image.image:title: Odeonsplatz, Munich
image:image.image:caption: At blue hour the floodlit yellow façade of the Theatinerkirche fills the centre, its twin towers with clock faces flanking the central gable and dome. The Feldherrnhalle loggia stands to the left, its arched bays and the statue and lions on the plinth picked out by warm lamplight. A tall street lamp glows in the right foreground beside café tables, a bicycle and a chalkboard reading 'Biergarten offen', all under a deep-blue evening sky.

image:image.image:title: Residenz and Hofgarten, Munich
image:image.image:caption: The arcaded ground-floor façade of the Residenz sweeps down the left side of the frame, its lit lanterns, benches and stone reliefs glowing warm against the night. The Dianatempel pavilion stands in the centre beyond the parterre beds and gravel paths, its arched openings and green patinated copper dome catching the light. A dark tree line and one lit building on the right horizon complete the square, under a deep-blue night sky with thin cloud.

image:image.image:title: Theresienwiese, Munich
image:image.image:caption: The lit Riesenrad Ferris wheel glows at the right with its carousel below, while the Hofbräu and Paulaner Festzelt fronts stand left and right of a rain-wet lane, Bavarian bunting strung overhead and the Bavaria statue on the skyline to the upper left. Visitors walk away from the camera down the reflective pavement under heavy overcast night skies, the 20:15 festival hour catching the tents, rides and food stalls in warm light against the dark, damp evening.

image:image.image:title: Plönlein, Rothenburg ob der Tauber
image:image.image:caption: The Plönlein's forked cobbled street opens toward the lantern-lit tower archway with its clock face on the left, while the crooked yellow half-timbered house stands at the center of the frame and a row of gabled houses with glowing shopfronts rises on the right. Warm lamplight pools on the cobbles under a clear starry night sky, with a red lantern sign and wrought-iron brackets hanging from the left-hand façades. The scene reads as the quiet Rothenburg old town at 20:45 on a clear 12.8°C September evening.

image:image.image:title: Town walls, Rothenburg ob der Tauber
image:image.image:caption: A night walk along the covered wall gallery of Rothenburg ob der Tauber: the timber-roofed rampart walkway stretches ahead with glowing wall lamps under dark beams, the mossy stone parapet running the right edge of the frame. To the left, a red half-timbered gabled house with lit windows stands among lamplit rooftops and wet cobblestones, while a tall stone watchtower rises in the middle distance beneath a moonlit, partly cloudy sky — no people, just the lamps and the moon on the ancient walls.

image:image.image:title: Old Town Hall, Bamberg
image:image.image:caption: From the river bank at night, the Old Town Hall glows against a deep blue starry sky — the tall gabled stone building and its cupola tower stand center, with the half-timbered annex filling the right of the frame, its windows lit warm yellow. A stone bridge arch crosses beneath the island to the left, river reflections shimmering below, while old town houses with lit windows crowd the right bank under the clear 12°C sky.

image:image.image:title: Little Venice, Bamberg
image:image.image:caption: From the river at night, Bamberg's Little Venice spreads across the frame — a row of historic fishermen's houses with half-timbered facades, red tile roofs and flower-box windows fills left to right, lit warm from streetlamps and glowing windows. Two wooden boats lie moored at the dark water in the foreground, and a bright moon hangs in the starry clear sky above the quiet 12°C scene.

image:image.image:title: Old Main Bridge, Würzburg
image:image.image:caption: Under a heavy overcast night sky, the Old Main Bridge spans the Main with its weathered stone arches and gilded saint statues along the parapet, streetlamps glowing amber. The Marienberg Fortress dominates the center background above dark vineyard terraces, while lit old-town houses line the right bank and lamplight shimmers on the river in the cool 12°C air.

image:image.image:title: Residence, Würzburg
image:image.image:caption: The Residence's long Baroque frontage glows from within across the Court Gardens, its ornate central pavilion rising above manicured parterres. Stone statues and lit garden lamps line the gravel paths left and right in the foreground, while the mansard roofs and sculpted pediments stand against a clear deep-blue night sky. A calm moonlit view of Würzburg's grandest palace from a tourist's eye-level stroll through the Hofgarten.

image:image.image:title: Imperial Castle, Nuremberg
image:image.image:caption: The floodlit round Sinwell Tower rises center above the castle ramparts, half-timbered buildings with warm windows crowding to its left. A cobbled path curves through the foreground beside a mossy stone wall, and at the right edge the lit rooftops and church spires of the old town spread into the distance. The moon hangs behind scattered clouds over Nuremberg's medieval stronghold.

image:image.image:title: Henkersteg, Nuremberg
image:image.image:caption: The covered wooden Henkersteg runs diagonally from the foreground toward the right, its open timber trusses and warm lamps glowing over the dark Pegnitz. The massive stone Henkerhaus with its tall pointed gable anchors the left, and lit old-town houses line the far bank. Moonlight breaks through scattered clouds, doubling the lights on the water.

image:image.image:title: Hauptmarkt, Nuremberg
image:image.image:caption: The Frauenkirche rises at the center of the Hauptmarkt, its brick Gothic westwork glowing against the night — the traceried clock gable and tall tower with its verdigris cupola lit from within by the church windows. Period buildings with lit windows frame the square at left and right, market stalls and café umbrellas closed up along the edges. Partly cloudy night skies drift above the tower, with the 22:45 floodlit warmth playing across the church’s west front.

image:image.image:title: Stone Bridge, Regensburg
image:image.image:caption: The medieval Stone Bridge stretches away from the viewer, its lantern-lit cobblestones glistening with rain past the low stone parapet. At center, the cathedral’s twin spires blaze floodlit gold above the dark gabled roofs of the old town, while the Danube at right doubles every light in long watery reflections. The mainly clear 22:45 sky is deep blue, and the lit waterfront houses crowd the right bank behind the bridge’s end arch.

image:image.image:title: Three-rivers old town, Passau
image:image.image:caption: Passau’s old town glows under a heavy overcast night sky, with St. Stephen’s Cathedral — its tower and green onion domes — lit at the center behind the quay’s row of pastel gabled houses. The Veste Oberhaus fortress glimmers from the wooded hill at the right edge, while at left the river carries long reflections of the quay lamps. Riverboats moor at the promenade in the foreground, and the 23:00 warmth of the lit town plays against the cold grey clouds overhead.

image:image.image:title: Harbor entrance, Lindau
image:image.image:caption: From the harbor mole at night, the stone Bavarian lion stands sentinel on its tall pedestal at the left, the floodlit round lighthouse rising at the right with its clock face and glowing lantern room. Moored boats line the lit promenade and its warm-windowed buildings at the right edge, mountain silhouettes lie across the calm lake under a starry clear sky, and golden reflections shimmer on the dark water beneath the harbor entrance.

image:image.image:title: Herrenchiemsee, Prien/Herreninsel
image:image.image:caption: From the garden basin at night, the New Palace's long floodlit façade stretches across the frame, its warm windows reflected in the calm water below. The reclining Latona-style statue group anchors the right foreground, a tall illuminated water jet rises at the left among fountain sculptures, and the palace glow carries across the dark park under a mainly clear sky.

image:image.image:title: Lakeside promenade, Tegernsee
image:image.image:caption: From the boardwalk at night, lit lamps and empty benches line the right while traditional Bavarian houses with green shutters edge the promenade. The tall church steeple rises mid-frame over moored boats, the calm lake spreads to the left mirroring the lamplight, and dark alpine foothills close the far shore beneath a partly cloudy sky with the moon breaking through.

image:image.image:title: St. Coloman, Schwangau
image:image.image:caption: St. Coloman glows in the middle of an open meadow at night, its white Baroque nave and tall onion-domed tower lit from within while a cluster of trees stands to the right and the silhouetted Alpine ridgelines fade behind. Moonlight breaks through the partly cloudy sky overhead, softening the meadow grass in the foreground and leaving the mountains as dark layered shapes.

image:image.image:title: Eremitage, Bayreuth
image:image.image:caption: The Eremitage Orangery curves around its domed central pavilion, the golden quadriga catching the light on top while rows of lamps glow inside the arcades on both wings. A circular fountain basin sits in the foreground of the formal parterre, its dark water reflecting the pavilion and the wet stone paths glisten from the overcast night. Sculptural fountain groups flank the manicured hedges left and right of the gravel walks.

image:image.image:title: Weinmarkt, Dinkelsbühl
image:image.image:caption: The Weinmarkt glows at midnight beneath a partly cloudy moonlit sky, a row of tall colorful gabled houses lining the cobbled square with warm light spilling from their windows. The Gasthaus Zur Glocke stands at the left with its inn sign over the doorway, next to a richly carved half-timbered facade hung with flower boxes, while the yellow ochre gables march right toward the far end of the square. Closed restaurant parasols and terracotta planters cluster along the right side, and the lamplit cobbles carry the reflection of every window.

image:image.image:title: Altstadt, Landshut
image:image.image:caption: The Altstadt lies quiet after midnight under a clear, star-speckled sky, the cobbled street empty and warm shopfront light glowing from a bakery and bookshop along the row of tall pastel gabled houses at the left. St. Martin's soaring brick Gothic tower rises at center-right, its clock face lit against the dark sky and the grand arched west portal warmly floodlit at its base. At the right, a ochre facade with an arched colonnade frames a late-night café, and the whole scene carries the hush of a Bavarian old town at 8.6°C.

image:image.image:title: Danube Gorge and Weltenburg, Kelheim
image:image.image:caption: Past midnight, Weltenburg Abbey glows warmly against a brooding overcast sky, its red roofs, domed church and green spire mirrored in the dark, still Danube in the foreground. Mist drifts over the steep limestone cliffs of the gorge at the left, fading into the gloom, while a rocky riverbank with moss and a gravel bar frames the near shore. The 9.5°C night air feels heavy and still, the abbey's lit windows the only signs of life along the black river.

image:image.image:title: Kallmünz, Kallmünz
image:image.image:caption: Under an overcast night sky, the Burgruine Kallmünz crowns the sheer Schlossberg rock directly above the village, its ruined towers silhouetted against the clouds. Below, a wet cobbled lane glints with street-lamp reflections, lined left and right by gabled houses with red tile roofs and green shutters; the village church with its onion-dome tower rises at the right. Fallen leaves drift across the stones in the 9.9°C damp, warm window light from a Gasthaus the only glow in the sleeping lane.

image:image.image:title: Großer Arber, Bavarian Forest
image:image.image:caption: The weathered summit cross stands at the left of the frame with its "Großer Arber · 1456 m" plaque, lichen-covered boulders underfoot in the foreground. The summit's two white radar radomes and the red-lit transmitter tower cluster center-right, with the lit mountain hut at the right edge, while dark forested slopes fall away toward scattered town lights in the valley below. A clear starry sky hangs over the late-night scene, the mountain-top air crisp under the mainly-clear night.

image:image.image:title: Treetop walk, Neuschönau
image:image.image:caption: The wooden treetop walkway curves through dark spruce forest from the foreground, its railing lights drawing a warm line toward the illuminated observation tower at the right — the tower's spiral ramp glowing amber against a starry, mainly-clear night sky. Tall firs crowd the left and center of the frame, their silhouettes fading into blue-black mist, and the whole path glows as if lit for a rare after-hours visitor.

image:image.image:title: Market square, Bremen
image:image.image:caption: A quiet morning on Bremen's Marktplatz under a flat overcast sky. The Roland statue stands at the right edge of frame with his heraldic shield, while the ornate Weser-Renaissance Town Hall fills the center with its gabled roofline and ground-floor arcades. The twin green-copper spires of St. Petri Dom rise behind the hall to the left, and wet cobblestones scattered with fallen leaves catch the grey early-morning light.

image:image.image:title: Town Musicians statue, Bremen
image:image.image:caption: The famous bronze Town Musicians of Bremen stand stacked four high — donkey, dog, cat and rooster — against the red brick wall of the Town Hall on the left. Across the empty morning square, a pale gabled Hanseatic façade with gold ornament faces the viewer at the right, with a lamppost and bench at the far edge. Wet cobblestones and fallen leaves catch the soft grey light of the overcast morning.

image:image.image:title: Schnoor, Bremen
image:image.image:caption: A narrow cobbled lane winds through Bremen's Schnoor quarter in the early morning. A ceramics shop with hanging dried flowers occupies the left foreground, while tilted half-timbered and gabled houses crowd both sides, their shopfronts — a bookshop sign, postcard racks, a chalkboard for hot chocolate and tea — just opening for the day. Wet cobblestones and grey overcast light complete the quiet scene.

image:image.image:title: Böttcherstraße, Bremen
image:image.image:caption: A quiet morning on Böttcherstraße, the gabled brick-expressionist facades of the old lane rising on both sides — the tall stepped-gable house at right with its dark 'Haus Atlantis' doorway, and the smaller red-tile-roofed houses at left where a 'Kunst & Handwerk' shop window glows beneath an awning. Wet cobblestones reflect the flat grey light of an overcast September morning, and the lane sits empty, as if the tourist hour hasn't quite begun.

image:image.image:title: Schlachte, Bremen
image:image.image:caption: Early morning on the Schlachte, Bremen's riverside promenade: historic sailing ships with furled sails lie moored at left along the grey Weser, while the brick restaurant row at right — Brasserie Schlachte, Café Möwe — stands quiet under folded parasols and empty tables. Across the river, the green spires of St. Martini and the cathedral towers rise into a low overcast sky, and wet paving stones glisten in the flat morning light before the crowds arrive.

image:image.image:title: St. Peter’s Cathedral, Bremen
image:image.image:caption: St. Peter's Cathedral rises at the end of the Domshof, its twin green-copper spires and arcaded Romanesque towers filling the frame, the rose window set between them and a clock on the north tower. At left the Roland statue watches over the market square; gabled townhouses and a bakery café crowd the right side. Wet cobbles, scattered autumn leaves and a low grey sky complete the quiet early-morning mood.

image:image.image:title: Havenwelten, Bremerhaven
image:image.image:caption: Overcast morning over the Havenwelten waterfront: the sail-shaped Sail City tower rises center-left of the frame with the Klimahaus's glass dome gleaming beside it, while moored boats crowd the marina between the promenade walkways at left and right. Flat grey light softens the harbour water and a dockside sign reads 'Havenwelten | Havenbecken', with seagulls wheeling over the masts in the middle distance.

image:image.image:title: New Harbor, Bremerhaven
image:image.image:caption: Grey morning light over the museum harbor: the red-brick Bremerhaven lighthouse with its green lantern stands left of the frame, the black museum tugboat 'WESER' lies mid-ground with its tall smokestack, and the historic sailing ship 'Ebbe' with her towering masts fills the right. A weathered 'Neuer Hafen · Historische Schiffe' sign leans on the quayside railing in the foreground while ducks and a gull ride the flat harbour water under a low overcast sky.

image:image.image:title: Fishing Harbor, Bremerhaven
image:image.image:caption: Wet-cobbled quayside under a heavy overcast sky: weathered fishing cutters 'BX 234' and 'BX 129' lie moored at right with coiled nets and orange buoys, while the brick fishery buildings run the length of the left — the 'PACKHALLE IV' fish restaurant with its green-striped awning and chalk menu board, and the 'FISCHAUCTION - Halle X' further along. Ice boxes, a life ring, and gulls on the mooring posts complete the working-harbor foreground.

image:image.image:title: Römerberg, Frankfurt
image:image.image:caption: The Römerberg's famous row of gabled timber-framed houses fills the frame from an eye-level viewpoint across the cobbled square: red and white half-timbered facades with flower boxes, steep slate gables, and ground-floor shop windows run from left to right under flat overcast skies. At the left edge, the green bronze fountain figure and a blue 'Römerberg · Rathaus' sign mark the square, while closed café umbrellas stand at the right. The 16.3°C damp cobbles gleam softly, and a lone pedestrian crosses the square in the 11:30 daylight.

image:image.image:title: Main skyline, Frankfurt
image:image.image:caption: From the Sachsenhausen riverbank, the Eiserner Steg's iron truss runs along the right edge of the frame, its railings crowded with padlocks, while the Main flows wide to the left under a flat overcast sky. The bankfull riverfront leads the eye to the skyline cluster — the Commerzbank Tower's rounded crown, the spired Messeturm, and the church spire at the old-town edge — standing in the soft, even light of a grey 11:45 morning. A tour boat is moored by the far quay, and damp paving on the embankment hints at recent rain.

image:image.image:title: Main Tower, Frankfurt
image:image.image:caption: From the Main Tower's open-air viewing deck, a rain-beaded railing crosses the foreground with the tower's own glass wall at the left edge. Below and beyond, the Kaiserdom rises in red sandstone mid-frame-left, the Main bends away with its bridges, and the banking quarter's skyscrapers — Commerzbank Tower, Messeturm, the Europaturm behind — pierce the low overcast at center and right. The whole grey 11:45 panorama reads damp and fresh after rain, exactly the post-shower view the platform is famous for.

image:image.image:title: Neue Altstadt, Frankfurt
image:image.image:caption: A cobbled lane in the reconstructed Hühnermarkt quarter runs between tall half-timbered houses: the black-beamed bakery with green shutters and flower boxes on the left, red-braced gabled façades at center, and a souvenir shop to the right beneath the blue Dom-Römer street sign. Closed café umbrellas, crates of apples, and a handwritten Tagesangebot board fill the midday-quiet street, while the Kaiserdom's Gothic tower rises at the far end of the lane under a heavy grey noon sky.

image:image.image:title: Palmengarten, Frankfurt
image:image.image:caption: From an eye-level path among the beds, the great glass-domed conservatory rises center frame over a brick arcade base, with a small wayfinding sign naming the Palmengarten at the right edge. Hydrangea bushes in pink and blue mass to the left and center, a lily pond and tall reeds at the lower right, and a wooden bench on the gravel path at the lower left. Under an overcast late-September sky the light is soft and diffuse, and fallen leaves fleck the path — an early-autumn day in the gardens.

image:image.image:title: Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe, Kassel
image:image.image:caption: From the foot of the cascade, the Hercules statue crowns the octagonal monument center frame, the steep stone watercourse dropping straight down the park axis toward the viewer. Dark conifers and autumn-tinged beeches line both sides of the slope, stone walls frame the cascade's base, and a yellow scaffold tower beside the watercourse suggests maintenance work in progress. Broken midday cloud lets soft light play across the wet stone and grass — a crisp early-autumn noon in the Bergpark.

image:image.image:title: Löwenburg, Kassel
image:image.image:caption: From a gravel park path, the stone Löwenburg rises center frame — round towers, crenellated parapets and slender spires ringed by early-autumn trees in gold, russet and green. A wooden bench and a vintage lamppost sit at the left edge of the foreground, wildflower borders line the path, and hazy hills stretch behind the rooftops. Broken cloud softens the midday sun, and fallen leaves speckle the path — a quiet late-September noon in the Bergpark.

image:image.image:title: Old town, Marburg
image:image.image:caption: The old town climbs in a steep cobbled lane, timber-framed houses with geranium boxes pressing in on both sides, while the castle tower crowns the hill above the rooftops. A bakery window glowing with pretzels stands left, an antiquarian bookshop right, and midday sun breaking through scattered clouds lifts the lane between soft shadows.

image:image.image:title: Landgrafenschloss, Marburg
image:image.image:caption: From the castle terrace, the Landgrafenschloss's sandstone walls and clock tower hold the left of the frame, a mossy parapet and weathered information plaque in the immediate foreground. Below, the Lahn bends through the old town's rooftops toward the slender church spire at the right, with green hills rolling beyond. Midday light under a partly cloudy sky keeps the river bright and the castle façade crisp.

image:image.image:title: Cathedral, Limburg an der Lahn
image:image.image:caption: The cathedral's red-and-white Romanesque towers rise above the Lahn, seen from the far riverbank across gently moving water. Leafy branches frame the left edge and bare riverside trees stand right, while a stone embankment wall runs the full width mid-frame. The overcast noon sky softens everything into muted tones, and the cathedral's rose window and seven spires read crisp against the grey.

image:image.image:title: Drosselgasse, Rüdesheim
image:image.image:caption: The narrow cobbled Drosselgasse runs between ivy-draped wine taverns under the flat grey daylight of the overcast 13:15 scenario. At left, the blue street sign hangs over a wrought-iron 'Weinstube · Rheingau' plaque and a chalkboard listing wine tastings, while a Sekt shop's glowing window and 'Sektkellerei Rheingau Sekt' fascia anchor the right. Flower boxes, trailing vines and wine barrels line the lane, and warm lamplight spills from the shop interiors against the cool midday sky.

image:image.image:title: Niederwald Monument, Rüdesheim
image:image.image:caption: The crowned Germania statue of the Niederwald Monument rises at upper left over its tiered stone base, with the terrace balustrade running along the hillside. Center and right open onto the panorama: steep vineyard terraces dropping to Rüdesheim's rooftops and the Rhine curving between its islands toward misty far hills. Soft overcast midday light flattens the colors to grey-greens and autumnal golds, matching the 13:15 scenario, and a vineyard path with a wooden rail leads into the foreground.

image:image.image:title: Rhine waterfront, Eltville
image:image.image:caption: The Electors' Castle's white residential tower with its slate spires dominates the right side above the old town wall, framed by tall trees. To the left stand Eltville's church towers and timbered houses above the Rhine, with moored excursion boats at the jetty. In the foreground, the wet promenade with its bench, lamp and 'Rheinuferpromenade' info panel reflects the overcast 13:30 daylight after rain, the river calm under the grey sky.

image:image.image:title: Market square, Fritzlar
image:image.image:caption: Fritzlar's market square spreads across the frame in warm midday light, the cobbled plaza hemmed by a row of tall half-timbered gabled houses in mustard, black-and-white and red timber. A stone fountain ringed with flower planters anchors the foreground right while cafe awnings and market stalls line the ground floors. A distant church tower rises over the rooftops, and soft broken clouds drift through a bright sky.

image:image.image:title: Edersee dam, Edertal
image:image.image:caption: The Edersee dam curves across the frame in flat overcast daylight, its weathered masonry gravity wall with twin towers and arched spillway crest dividing the grey reservoir from the power plant buildings below. Forested hills hem the reservoir on both sides, small tree-topped islands dotting the water mid-frame. A visitor railing runs along the bottom edge, placing the camera on the familiar terrace viewpoint.

image:image.image:title: Waldeck Castle, Waldeck
image:image.image:caption: Waldeck Castle stands on the wooded hilltop above the Edersee, its slate roofs and pale stone towers framed at the right edge while the grey lake fills the frame left and center. Rain falls lightly: raindrop rings spread across the water, mossy stones glisten in the wet foreground, and low clouds blur the far forested shore. A boat jetty reaches into the lake at mid-frame.

image:image.image:title: Wasserkuppe, Gersfeld
image:image.image:caption: From a grassy summit path on the Wasserkuppe, the iconic Radom radar dome rises at the right edge of the frame while a wooden signpost marking "Wasserkuppe 950 m" stands in the left foreground. Wildflowers dot the foreground grasses, a gravel path curves through the open Rhön landscape, and rolling green hills stretch to the horizon under a partly cloudy early-afternoon sky.

image:image.image:title: Cathedral and palace, Fulda
image:image.image:caption: From the cobbled plaza, Fulda Cathedral's twin onion-spired towers rise in striped Baroque brick at center-right, flanked by its cupola-crowned domes, while a slate-roofed Baroque palace with a flower-banked balcony fills the left of the frame. Autumn leaves scatter across the damp cobbles and a "Domplatz" sign marks the square, all under broken afternoon cloud in mild late-September air.

image:image.image:title: Market square, Alsfeld
image:image.image:caption: Alsfeld's famed timber-framed Town Hall fills the left of the frame, its stone ground-floor arcade and twin slate spires rising above the timber upper floors. Across the cobbled market square, a row of red- and brown-timbered gabled houses lines the right side, with café chairs, flower planters, and parked cars scattered through the foreground under broken afternoon cloud.

image:image.image:title: Wasserschloss, Speicherstadt
image:image.image:caption: The Wasserschloss stands at the tip of the Speicherstadt, its white-and-brick corner tower and green copper spirelets rising where the canals meet. Red-brick warehouse blocks flank the water left and right, and two iron canal bridges arc across the dark, rain-dimpled water. Under a grey overcast sky the early-morning drizzle softens the light, and an empty café terrace of stacked chairs sits at the water's edge.

image:image.image:title: Warehouse canals, Speicherstadt
image:image.image:caption: A narrow canal runs between long red-brick warehouse blocks, their facades mirrored in the rain-dimpled water. The near bank shows a wet cobblestone quay with mooring bollards, rope, and rain-streaked railings; a low iron bridge crosses the canal in the misty distance. Flat overcast daylight and visible drizzle match the scenario, with a small wall display echoing the weather readout.

image:image.image:title: Elbphilharmonie, HafenCity
image:image.image:caption: The Elbphilharmonie's wave-like glass crown rises over its brick Kaispeicher base, the curved roofline dominating the frame from the Sandtorkai quay. Moored boats bob in the foreground, and wet pavement glistens under flat overcast light with drizzle in the air. Harbor cranes stand faint on the right horizon, and a few distant pedestrians cross the quay with umbrellas.

image:image.image:title: St. Michaelis, Neustadt
image:image.image:caption: The Michel's tall baroque tower — clock face, green copper gallery and spire — rises at the end of a cobbled Neustadt street, its red-brick nave with tall arched windows to the right. Timber-framed houses with green and blue shutters line the left side, a bookshop and bakery terrace with flower boxes in the foreground. Overcast morning light, damp cobbles, parked bicycles along the kerb; a calm, empty-of-crowds street view at eye level.

image:image.image:title: Landungsbrücken, St. Pauli
image:image.image:caption: The sandstone Landungsbrücken building with its green copper dome and clock tower stands at the left, a steel truss gangway reaching out to the floating pontoons. A blue-and-white HADAG harbor ferry lies moored center frame, a container ship and harbor cranes soft in the mist across the Elbe. Overcast, rain-damp morning light, wet stone and rippling grey water; an HVV ferry departure board at the right edge — the working harbor as a tourist sees it.

image:image.image:title: Old Elbe Tunnel, St. Pauli/Steinwerder
image:image.image:caption: The tiled arched bore of the Old Elbe Tunnel frames the scene, with the glass crown of the Elbphilharmonie rising left across the Elbe, the harbor-crane skyline stretching through the middle, and the Steinwerder quay — railings, bollards and weather-wet asphalt — filling the right foreground under a flat overcast morning sky. The tunnel lamps glow warm against the damp tiles.

image:image.image:title: Jungfernstieg, Neustadt
image:image.image:caption: From the Jungfernstieg promenade the Binnenalster stretches across the frame: a classic globe lamp and parked bicycles stand left, historic brick and stone façades with green copper roofs line the far bank, and the glass Alster pavilion with its café terrace and folded umbrellas anchors the right under a flat overcast morning sky. Alster excursion boats cross the mid-distance on the grey water.

image:image.image:title: Außenalster, Rotherbaum/Uhlenhorst
image:image.image:caption: From a reed-lined bank the calm grey water of the Außenalster fills the frame, swans and ducks drifting left, a small jetty with rowboats tucked at the right, and the villa-lined north bank running through the middle toward the distant downtown towers under a heavy overcast sky. The moody autumn light and still water give the lake its quiet morning character.

image:image.image:title: Chilehaus, Altstadt
image:image.image:caption: The Chilehaus's sharp expressionist brick prow rises center-right above rain-slick cobblestones, its rows of white-framed windows climbing both sides of the corner under a flat grey sky. Left of frame, a Burchardstraße café front tucks behind folded green-striped umbrellas beneath a blue Altstadt street sign, with bicycles parked along the curb. The wet pavement mirrors the overcast light, giving the whole scene the damp sheen of a light mid-morning rain.

image:image.image:title: Treppenviertel, Blankenese
image:image.image:caption: A steep cobbled staircase climbs between tightly packed hillside houses, its stone treads glistening with damp under a soft overcast sky. Hydrangeas, ivy, and potted flowers crowd the left-hand wall while a half-timbered cottage with geranium window boxes anchors the right. A brown sign at the top of the steps points walkers on to the Treppenviertel, with more houses stacked up the misty hill behind.

image:image.image:title: Övelgönne, Othmarschen
image:image.image:caption: Historic wooden sailing ships of the museum harbor rest at their jetties across the middle of the frame, with the "Museumshafen Övelgönne" sign standing on the sandy beach in the right foreground. Driftwood, pebbles, and dune grass fill the foreground while hillside houses stack up behind the harbor under a pale overcast sky. The calm grey Elbe and muted light carry the damp stillness of a mid-morning with no sun.

image:image.image:title: Fish Auction Hall, St. Pauli
image:image.image:caption: A tourist's eye-level view along the Elbe side of Hamburg's historic Fish Auction Hall: the brick-and-iron market corridor stretches left past wooden stalls with ice-filled fish crates, while tall arched windows on the right frame the Elbe and moored boats beyond. Wet cobblestones and an overcast brightness through the windows carry the slight-rain morning; handwritten German price boards for Kabeljau, Scholle and Nordseekrabben and a crate stencil reading NORDSEE - FRISCHFISCH - HAMBURG anchor the authentic market feel.

image:image.image:title: Reeperbahn, St. Pauli
